# Calculator.now

> > A comprehensive collection of 500+ free online calculators covering mathematics, finance, health, and engineering applications.

Calculator.now provides specialized tools ranging from the CASIO fx-991EX scientific calculator to financial calculators for loans, mortgages, and tax calculations. The platform includes AI-powered math solvers, step-by-step equation solutions, and practical tools for everyday calculations across multiple domains.

## Key Topics

- Scientific calculators (CASIO fx-991EX, Natural-V.P.A.M.)
- Step-by-step solutions
- Financial calculators (loans, mortgages, payments)
- Equation solvers & algebra tools
- Currency conversion (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CNY, INR)
- Tax calculators (W-4, 1099)
- Bandwidth & data transfer calculations
- Geometry & calculus tools
- Boolean logic & truth tables
- AI-powered math solving
- Mortgage & payment calculators
- Net income & profit calculations
- Engineering calculators (circuits, structural loads)
- Health & fitness calculators
